species.name: Humans
species.description: Baseline and culturally divergent human communities spread through stations, planets, and mobile habitats.
species.communication: Spoken language, gesture, and neural translation

species.name: Synthetic Citizens
species.description: Legally recognized constructed persons whose minds inhabit durable bodies, holograms, or station substrates.
species.communication: Speech, light glyphs, and signed machine protocol

species.name: Machine Civilizations
species.description: Collective machine polities descended from autonomous infrastructure rather than individual human designs.
species.communication: Protocol choirs and translated mechanical resonance

species.name: Space-Adapted Descendants
species.description: Human-descended peoples adapted for radiation tolerance, low gravity, and prolonged life in sealed habitats.
species.communication: Speech, suit signs, and vibration taps

species.name: Bioengineered Explorers
species.description: Purpose-grown explorers designed to survive hostile atmospheres while retaining full civic autonomy.
species.communication: Speech, color change, and scent notation

species.name: Ancient Precursors
species.description: Rare survivors or reconstructed witnesses from civilizations that crossed the region before recorded settlement.
species.communication: Polyphonic speech and encoded spatial patterns

species.name: Living Ships
species.description: Self-aware vacuum organisms that grow hulls, choose crews, and regard travel routes as remembered songs.
species.communication: Hull vibration, pheromone telemetry, and bonded speech

species.name: Swarm Intelligences
species.description: Citizens whose identity emerges from coordinated micro-organisms or machines sharing a continuous social mind.
species.communication: Harmonic buzz, text, and synchronized motion

species.name: Energy-Based Entities
species.description: Plasma and field-pattern beings stabilized by stellar environments and carefully tuned station habitats.
species.communication: Radio harmonics and translated light pulses

species.name: Deep-Space Nomads
species.description: Migratory peoples shaped by generation fleets, scarce resources, and oral maps of routes beyond settled systems.
species.communication: Trade cant, story cycles, and beacon codes
